_status: unresolved. Model ids are pinned before any analyst runs (unit 2.4).
_replay_note: Deterministic replay comes from recorded model outputs, including the risk output. Seeds apply to our own code only and prove nothing about model determinism. See LESSONS 2026-09-17.
_analyst_model_note: Provisional. It is the model 0.9 measured (findings F0.9.1). The final choice is made at unit 2.4, where the 139x cost spread across the gateway's models (F0.9.5) is tested against output quality.
_model_resolved_by: unit 2.4, informed by unit 1.7 and by the 0.9 floor, which priced the same tokens across the catalogue (findings F0.9.5)
_max_output_tokens_note: Null, so replies are uncapped and no deadline can be derived from a cap. 1.7's analyst replies billed 7,725 and 9,087 output tokens, about 37-50% of it absent from the reply text (inferred: hidden reasoning, F1.7.5). Recommended at 1.7, not set: about 12,000.
_worker_deadline_note: Provisional. One analyst call took 58 s at the 0.9 floor (F0.9.1). Against a real snapshot, 1.7 measured 62.4 and 75.0 s at ~121 output tokens/s, while 0.9's rate was ~17, so a reply like 1.7's could take ~535 s. Recommended at 1.7, not set: at least the transport timeout plus a margin, e.g. 630 (research/findings.md F1.7.4). It is shorter than transport_timeout_seconds (180); see that note.
_transport_timeout_note: Provisional (decision before unit 1.1). It exceeds the 58 s measured for one analyst call (findings F0.9.1), because a client-side timeout is still billed and is a cost with no report (F0.9.3). It is longer than worker_deadline_seconds (120), so inside the 2.4 runner the deadline fires first and this never does. That interaction is recorded in tracker/LESSONS.md and left for 2.4 to resolve. 1.7 measured 62-75 s against a real snapshot, and recommends at least 600 s, derived from an output cap and the slowest rate measured (F1.7.4); not set here, because the value is 2.4's.
_context_budget_note: Must cover every accepted full report plus the sized plan and the risk output. If the bundle does not fit, the cycle vetoes rather than summarizing (planning/PLAN.md section 2 invariant 3).
